name: tonic-ui-monorepo
description: Tonic UI is a themeable UI component library built on top of Emotion and Styled System.

scripts.clean: lerna exec --parallel -- yarn clean && lerna clean --yes
scripts.docs-dev: yarn build-public; cd packages/react-docs; yarn dev
scripts.lerna-publish: yarn build && yarn lint && yarn test && lerna publish --no-private
scripts.lerna-publish-from-git: yarn build && yarn lint && yarn test && lerna publish from-git --no-private
scripts.lerna-publish-from-package: yarn build && yarn lint && yarn test && lerna publish from-package --no-private

author: Cheton Wu
